name: vFlow
description: Enterprise Network Flow Collector supporting IPFIX, sFlow, and Netflow. High-performance, scalable collector written in pure Go.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker image available as mehrdadrad/vflow with port mappings for IPFIX (4739), NetFlow (4729), sFlow (6343).

eval_notes: Enterprise-grade flow collector from Verizon/Edgio. Good for evaluations requiring multi-protocol flow collection with Kafka output.
